title: Why your brain replays that embarrassing moment at 3AM

lines.text: You're just about to fall asleep…
and your brain goes: hey, remember when the waiter said enjoy your meal…
Your brain files embarrassing moments as social danger.
For our ancestors, getting kicked out of the group was a real threat.
So your brain hits replay, to make sure you never do it again.
The waiter forgot about it the same day.
It's called the spotlight effect: people notice your mistakes way less than you think,
because they're too busy replaying their own.
